# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Need to decide whether 'last' refers to latest created_at or latest approved_at; will use latest approved_at among approved requests.</uncertainty>
import re
from datetime import datetime

def parse_dt(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except Exception:
        return None

# Ensure we have all sent payment requests data
if 'all_reqs' not in globals():
    access_token=venmo_token
    all_reqs=[]
    page_limit=20
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res=apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
        print('page',page_index,'count',len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        all_reqs.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
    print('fetched_total',len(all_reqs))

candidates=[r for r in all_reqs
            if r.get('receiver',{}).get('name') and re.search('brandon', r['receiver']['name'], re.I)
            and r.get('approved_at')]
print('brandon_approved_sent_requests_count',len(candidates))

# Sort by approved_at
for r in candidates:
    r['_approved_dt']=parse_dt(r.get('approved_at'))

candidates_sorted=sorted(candidates, key=lambda r: (r['_approved_dt'] or datetime.min))
last=candidates_sorted[-1] if candidates_sorted else None

print('last_approved_request_payment_request_id', last.get('payment_request_id') if last else None)
print('last_approved_request_amount', last.get('amount') if last else None)
print('last_approved_request_receiver_name', last.get('receiver',{}).get('name') if last else None)
print('last_approved_request_receiver_email', last.get('receiver',{}).get('email') if last else None)
print('last_approved_request_created_at', last.get('created_at') if last else None)
print('last_approved_request_approved_at', last.get('approved_at') if last else None)
